source.description: Reviewed handmade raster marker-process contact sheet, cropped only after full-sheet review.
source.notes: One face-free folded taco with one tiny hot-sauce bottle beside it; no text, arrows, UI, signatures, or watermarks.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels build a taco scaffold, folded shell, filling layers, sauce bottle and details, marker color map, then a finish-only pass.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 using one taco crescent guide, one filling line, a small bottle rectangle, and two sauce-drop ticks.

anchor_map.early_mark: Open taco crescent and horizontal filling guide
anchor_map.becomes: One folded taco shell with its filling opening
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The filling remains centered inside the crescent opening.
anchor_map.construction_note: No completed shell contour in Panel 1.

anchor_map.early_mark: Small bottle rectangle and two drop ticks
anchor_map.becomes: One hot-sauce bottle with two small sauce drops
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The bottle stays beside the taco on the lower right and the drops remain between bottle and taco.

final_elements.name: taco shell and filling scaffold
final_elements.description: One upright golden taco shell with brown filling, green lettuce, and red tomato pieces.

final_elements.name: hot-sauce bottle and drops
final_elements.description: One small red hot-sauce bottle beside the taco with exactly two sauce drops.

final_elements.name: marker palette
final_elements.description: Thick black outlines, golden shell, brown filling, green lettuce, red accents, and small navy shadow.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The taco guide stays open around its filling route so no keeper line needs erasing.

frames.visible_job: Place one open taco crescent, one filling guide, one small bottle rectangle, and two sauce-drop ticks.
Connect only the thick folded taco shell over the crescent guide.
must_not_show: fillings bottle details sauce drops black outline or color

frames.visible_job: Add brown filling, one wavy lettuce strip, and small tomato pieces inside the established shell.
must_not_show: bottle cap sauce drops black outline or marker color

frames.visible_job: Turn the rectangle into one small bottle and the two ticks into exactly two sauce drops.
must_not_show: marker color or new food items

frames.visible_job: Ink established contours and map golden, brown, green, red, and navy marker regions.
must_not_show: new shell filling bottle or sauce geometry

final_step.visible_job: Only complete established marker fills, reinforce keeper lines, and add tiny existing highlights and shadow accents.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel or a panel that reveals fillings, bottle, drops, or colors early.
Reject a sheet with a shifted bottle, more than two drops, vector-like fills, or a final that adds new structure.
